messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw a cluster of silent WS stalls in eu-west between 09:12-09:18. Clients switch from wifi->cell and the socket never fully reestablishes; console shows reconnects but billing/token counters keep incrementing.
aj: Hmm. Do you have a trace id for one of these sessions?
maria: trace=trc_3a9f, pasted logs below. socket accepted, client sends upgrade, then NAT mapping changes, server logs keepalive ack but no final close.
maria: ```
[09:12:01] accept conn id=abc
[09:12:03] upgrade ok session=trc_3a9f
[09:12:20] keepalive recv ping id=42 -> pong sent
[09:12:23] client IP switched 10.1.2.3 -> 100.64.12.7 (prob NAT)
[09:12:23] no new handshake from client for session trc_3a9f
[09:12:40] server still reporting session active for billing
```
ryan: So the proxy doesn't see a TCP FIN, client silently moved IP. We treat session as live because opaque session lease is still valid. That would explain billing drift.
sofia: Right — downstream app thinks session alive (lease TTL), upstream client thinks it's dead. Need better telemetry to correlate network-change events to billing increments.
aj: Two quick asks: 1) can we tag session lifecycle events with network-change+client-ip in traces? 2) Add a metric: session_move_count{route,region} so console can show heatmap.
maria: I can add client-ip tags in the trace span for the next hour, but we shouldn't ship global because of pii rules. Need to hash/ip-prefix.
ryan: For immediate mitigation, can we reduce lease TTL for opaque sessions when we detect a NAT/gateway churn signal? e.g., if client IP changes without handshake, set lease to 10s then expire.
sofia: UI/console asks: show per-session last-seen-client-ip (hashed) and a small sparkline for token consumption so support can correlate. Also show 'network-change' flags in timeline.
aj: Implementation notes: edge-proxy can emit an event when it observes SYN from a new 5-tuple within Xs of last activity. We'll pipe that to session-service via event bus with tag event=session_move.
maria: I can cobble a quick patch to edge-agent to emit event=session_move (hashed_ip, prev_hashed_ip, session_id). Will test on staging.
ryan: Caveat: we risk false positives for mobile roam. Maybe a cooldown window before we shrink lease.
sofia: For dashboard, a boolean column 'session_move' and aggregation by customer+route. Ops wants alert if session_move_rate > 0.5% p95 in 5m.
aj: Also telemetry: we should add a counter of billing_tokens_emitted_by_session vs session_active_seconds to detect drift.
maria: Reproduced locally with my phone: NAT change triggers silent stall on ws client libs that don't redial. I can share a repro script.
maria: repro: connect ws, then do `ip route change` or toggle hotspot -> see no TCP FIN, server remains sticky.
ryan: Next steps: maria deploy patch to staging edge (canary), add session_move metric + hashed-ip trace tag; aj to wire metric into console backend; sofia to design tiny tile and alert.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: edge-agent-v0.7.3-canary -> eu-west (3 hosts)
maria: Canary up, logs show event=session_move emitted for the repro traces.
aj: Pulled sample metrics — session_move_count=12, token_drift_ratio (session) ~0.9 in the test window.
sofia: Drafted dashboard mock and slack screenshot uploaded to #product-dashboards.
ryan: If canary looks good, let's run a limited traffic rollout and set lease shrink to 15s when event=session_move observed. We can revert quickly.
maria: Agree. Also adding a debug header `X-Debug-Session-Move:1` to the client to force logging for QA.
aj: Ops asks: add a one-time migration task to backfill session_move signals over the last 48h (sampled) so we can estimate real-world impact.
sofia: I'll open a console ticket for the tile + alert.
maria: Thanks all — will report back in 30m with canary metrics. :thumbsup:
